project.name: Gimle Gateway
project.description: A self-hosted, Tier-2 module giving Gimle a north-south HTTP story: proxies incoming HTTP requests either into the platform's own service fabric via ModuleContext's name-driven invocation path (com.gimle.module.lifecycle.ServiceRegistry#invokeByName, a FABRIC route -- a gateway route names its target service through runtime config rather than a compile-time generic interface type) or, for a VESSEL route, straight through to a live instance of a named deployment, resolved via ModuleContext#relayControlPlaneRead against the control plane's own GET /endpoints/{name} and cached with a short TTL. Deployed as a real DaemonSet onto operator-labeled edge nodes, into the reserved gimle-system tenant -- a first-party platform component, not an example/sample module. com.gimle.module, com.gimle.core, and org.slf4j are declared `requires static`, not `requires`, for the same boot-only-platform-layer reason every other hosted module in this codebase declares them that way -- see ModuleLayerFactory's own javadoc in gimle-module.
